title: Nuevo Laredo brings 'Empleo en tu Colonia' job fair to Soriana Carrizo on Friday, Nov. 13
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is taking its 'Empleo en tu Colonia' job fair to the Soriana Carrizo parking lot on Friday, Nov. 13, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., with openings from customs agencies, commercial and service companies, and transporters. Job seekers should bring a resume; those who cannot attend can apply online.
content:
Job opportunities are coming directly to the neighborhoods of Nuevo Laredo. The municipal government is holding a new edition of its “Empleo en tu Colonia” job fair on Friday, November 13, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., in the parking lot of Soriana Carrizo, at Belden #7435 in Colonia Buena Vista, according to Desde Donde Estamos.

At the fair, residents will be able to learn about available openings and meet directly with companies looking to hire. Businesses from several sectors are taking part, including customs agencies, commercial and service companies, and transporters, with the goal of widening job placement options and making it easier for employers and job seekers to connect in person.

People who want to take part should bring a job application or résumé and register in advance at https://ee.kobotoolbox.org/x/ogVZQqy4, the report said.

For those who cannot attend in person, the municipal government also offers the platform www.bolsadeempleo.com.mx, where job seekers can look up openings and apply online.

The city says the job fairs are part of its push to boost economic development, strengthen the link between employers and residents, and bring services and opportunities closer to families across Nuevo Laredo.

Sources: Desde Donde Estamos, Armando Castillo Gutiérrez (Nov. 12, 2026).
